brief:
Palestinian Minister of Tourism and Antiquities Hani Al-Hayek addressed global leaders at the 12th St. Petersburg Forum in Russia's cultural capital, the Palestine News Network reported. Al-Hayek presented Palestinian cultural heritage and tourism initiatives as part of broader international discussions.

The forum brought together policymakers and officials to discuss development priorities across nations. Palestine's delegation participated alongside representatives from other countries in the gathering.
